grammar.authorship: Six original four-choice items24options, role/verb tables, five-step diagram, full distractor explanations, two transfer rewrites and ambiguous fragment.
questions: 第 1 題：The display panels ____ by the installation team yesterday. (A) install (B) were installing (C) were installed (D) installation
第 2 題：The installation team ____ the display panels yesterday. (A) was installed (B) installed (C) has been installed (D) installation
第 3 題：All fragile items must ____ in protective material before shipment. (A) wrapping (B) be wrapping (C) wrapped (D) be wrapped
第 4 題：The new application has already ____ by the legal team. (A) been reviewed (B) review (C) being reviewed (D) be reviewed
第 5 題：At 9:15 yesterday, the loading area ____ by two cleaners, so drivers waited outside. (A) cleaned (B) had cleaned (C) was being cleaned (D) is cleaning
第 6 題：According to the current timetable, the evening shuttle ____ at the east gate every day. (A) is arrived (B) arrives (C) arrived (D) has been arrived
logic: 1 panels receive installation by named team, past plural passive wereinstalled; noun option not predicate.
2 team executes installation with directobjectpanels; pastactive installed. Passive distractors leave unintended team-as-patient and barepanels.
3 fragileitems receive wrapping, must+be+pastparticiple. Given -ing/participlealone distractors cannot express intended standard structure.
4 provided hasalready requires beenreviewed, not hasbeing/hasbe or infinitive review; no duplicatehas when filling.
5 past9:15 ongoing cleaning of area by namedcleaners, wasbeingcleaned; active distractors reverse role or change present.
6 currenttimetable+everyday, intransitive arrivesatlocation; isarrived/hasbeenarrived not intended standard use, pastarrived mismatches currenttimetable.
rewrites: Dispatchteam checkedlabels thismorning -> labels werechecked bydispatchteam thismorning; preserves agent/patient/time.
Technicians aretesting backupunit now -> backupunit isbeingtested bytechnicians now; preserves progress, not completion.
grammar.limits: by noon is temporal, no agent guarantee. Agent may be omitted. Scanner inanimate can act; arrive has no directobject here. Isolated Thedoorisclosed permits state/passive readings with context; not forced unique seventhtest. No all-ed adjective/passive shortcut.
grammar.arithmetic: 6×4=24 original options; no official calibrated score or question-frequency estimate.
